notes.subject: a gana
notes.rationale: תכחש e bolela go se bolela nnete / go gana ka molomo — sebopego sa go gana se laetša go hlwa ka molomo

notes.subject: צחק
notes.rationale: Seaka se boletšwe gate tharo temaneng ye le kgauswi (18:12–14); sehlodi se a boela — kgopolo ya lebitso la Yitshake e dula gona

notes.subject: ויאמר
notes.rationale: Mmuši ga a hlaloswa; mašwa a re ke Yahwe, ba bangwe ba re ke lengoi le tee — Sepedi se oketša ⟨Yahwe⟩ go hlakantšha

notes.subject: ⟨Yahwe⟩
notes.rationale: Leina le okeditšwe ka gare ga masakana go hlakantšha moo o sa ngwalwago

notes.subject: Sara
notes.rationale: Yahwe o arabela Sara a isiša pelo go yena: o gana sephetho sa yena

translation: Sara a gana, a re: Ga kea seaka, ka gobane ke be ke tšhaba; gomme ⟨Yahwe⟩ a re: Aowa, eupša wena o ile wa seaka.
